```{r , echo=FALSE}
## WHO 2011 Dataset
df_2011_selected <- df_2011 %>%
  separate_rows(year, sep = "-") %>% #separate rows with multiple years
  mutate(           
        year = as.integer(year),
        longitude = as.numeric(longitude),
        latitude = as.numeric(latitude),
        concentration = as.numeric(annual_mean_concentration),
        ) %>%
  select(
    region, 
    country, 
    city, 
    year, 
    version = source_year, 
    pollutant, 
    longitude, 
    latitude, 
    concentration, 
    nb_locations, 
    reference
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    presence = if_else(is.na(concentration), "no", "yes")
  )

```

```{r , echo=FALSE}

## WHO 2014 Dataset
df_2014_selected <- df_2014 %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(annualmean_pm25, concentration_pm10),
    names_to = "pollutant",
    values_to = "concentration"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    pollutant = case_when(
      pollutant == "annualmean_pm25" ~ "pm25",
      pollutant == "concentration_pm10" ~ "pm10"
    ),
    year_raw = case_when(
      pollutant == "pm25" ~ as.character(yearpm25),
      pollutant == "pm10" ~ as.character(year_pm10),
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    city = city_station
  ) %>%
  separate_rows(year_raw, sep = "-") %>%
  mutate(
    year = as.integer(year_raw),             
    concentration = as.numeric(concentration),
    longitude_num = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(longitude)),
    latitude_num = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(latitude)),
    longitude = ifelse(
      longitude_num >= -180 & longitude_num <= 180,
      longitude_num,
      NA_real_
    ),
    latitude = ifelse(
      latitude_num >= -90 & latitude_num <= 90,
      latitude_num,
      NA_real_
    )
  ) %>%
  select(
    region,
    country,
    city,
    year,
    version = source_year,
    pollutant,
    longitude,
    latitude,
    concentration,
    nb_locations,
    reference
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    presence = if_else(is.na(concentration), "no", "yes")
  )

```

```{r}

## Standardise Country Names

library(dplyr)
library(countrycode)
library(stringdist)

df_all <- df_all %>%
  mutate(
    country = iconv(country, from = "", to = "UTF-8"),
)

df_all <- df_all %>%
  mutate(
    country_standard = countrycode(country, origin = "country.name", destination = "country.name")
  )

unmatched <- df_all %>%
  filter(is.na(country_standard)) %>%
  distinct(country)

official_names <- unique(countrycode::codelist$country.name.en)

fuzzy_matches <- unmatched %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    country_matched = official_names[which.min(stringdist(country, official_names, method = "jw"))]
  )

df_all <- df_all %>%
  left_join(fuzzy_matches, by = "country") %>%
  mutate(
    country_standard = coalesce(country_standard, country_matched)
  ) %>%
  select(-country_matched)

df_all %>%
  filter(country != country_standard) %>%
  select(country, country_standard) %>%
  distinct()

unique(df_all$country_standard)
df_all %>%
  count(country_standard, sort = TRUE)


```

```{r}

library(dplyr)
library(stringdist)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)

city_list <- df_all %>%
  count(country, city_clean, name = "n") %>%
  filter(!is.na(city_clean))

city_pairs <- city_list %>%
  group_by(country) %>%
  summarise(
    pairings = list(
      expand.grid(city1 = city_clean, city2 = city_clean, stringsAsFactors = FALSE) %>%
        filter(city1 < city2) %>%
        mutate(dist = stringdist(city1, city2, method = "jw"))
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  unnest(pairings)

thresholds <- seq(0.05, 0.5, by = 0.01)

match_counts <- sapply(thresholds, function(t) {
  city_pairs %>%
    filter(dist < t) %>%
    nrow()
})

plot_df <- data.frame(threshold = thresholds, matches = match_counts)

# Step 4: Plot match count vs threshold
ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = threshold, y = matches)) +
  geom_line(color = "steelblue") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0.15, linetype = "dashed", color = "red") +
  labs(
    title = "Fuzzy Match Volume by Jaro-Winkler Distance Threshold",
    x = "Distance Threshold",
    y = "Number of Matched Pairs"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()


```

```{r}

## Automatic Matching for distance below 0.1

library(dplyr)
library(stringdist)
library(tidyr)

city_list <- df_all %>%
  count(country, city_clean, name = "n") %>%
  filter(!is.na(city_clean))

fuzzy_map <- city_list %>%
  group_by(country) %>%
  summarise(
    pairings = list({
      expand.grid(city1 = city_clean, city2 = city_clean, stringsAsFactors = FALSE) %>%
        filter(city1 < city2) %>%
        mutate(dist = stringdist(city1, city2, method = "jw")) %>%
        filter(dist < 0.1) #find balanced number between more false negative (0.15) or more false positive (0.5)
    }),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  unnest(pairings)

fuzzy_map <- fuzzy_map %>%
  left_join(city_list, by = c("country", "city1" = "city_clean")) %>%
  rename(n1 = n) %>%
  left_join(city_list, by = c("country", "city2" = "city_clean")) %>%
  rename(n2 = n) %>%
  mutate(
    standard = if_else(n1 >= n2, city1, city2),
    to_replace = if_else(n1 >= n2, city2, city1)
  ) %>%
  select(country, to_replace, standard, n1, n2, dist) %>%
  distinct()

fuzzy_map_dedup <- fuzzy_map %>%
  group_by(country, to_replace) %>%
  slice_min(order_by = dist, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup()

df_all <- df_all %>%
  left_join(fuzzy_map_dedup, by = c("country", "city_clean" = "to_replace")) %>%
  mutate(city_clean = coalesce(standard, city_clean)) %>%
  select(-standard)

df_all %>%
  count(country, city_clean, sort = FALSE) %>%
  arrange(country, city_clean)

```

```{r}

## Manual Matching for distance between 0.1 and 0.25

fuzzy_review <- city_list %>%
  group_by(country) %>%
  summarise(
    pairings = list({
      expand.grid(city1 = city_clean, city2 = city_clean, stringsAsFactors = FALSE) %>%
        filter(city1 < city2) %>%
        mutate(dist = stringdist(city1, city2, method = "jw")) %>%
        filter(dist >= 0.1, dist < 0.25)
    }),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  unnest(pairings)

fuzzy_review <- fuzzy_review %>%
  left_join(city_list, by = c("country", "city1" = "city_clean")) %>%
  rename(n1 = n) %>%
  left_join(city_list, by = c("country", "city2" = "city_clean")) %>%
  rename(n2 = n) %>%
  mutate(
    suggested_standard = if_else(n1 >= n2, city1, city2),
    to_review = if_else(n1 >= n2, city2, city1)
  ) %>%
  select(country, to_review, suggested_standard, n1, n2, dist) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  group_by(country, to_review) %>%
  slice_min(order_by = dist, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup()

readr::write_csv(fuzzy_review, "cache/manual_city_review_0.1_to_0.25.csv")

```

```{r}

## First wave Geocoding Batching - Manual

library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(tidygeocoder)

cache_path <- "cache/cache_geocoded_city_country.csv"

df_all <- df_all %>%
  mutate(
    new_latitude = if (!"new_latitude" %in% names(.)) NA_real_ else new_latitude,
    new_longitude = if (!"new_longitude" %in% names(.)) NA_real_ else new_longitude
  )

# check cache
if (file.exists(cache_path)) {
  geo_cache_wave1<- read_csv(cache_path, show_col_types = FALSE)
} else {
  geo_cache_wave1<- tibble(country = character(), city = character(), new_latitude = numeric(), new_longitude = numeric())
}

# subset rows with missing coordinates
missing_coords <- df_all %>%
  filter(is.na(new_latitude) | is.na(new_longitude)) %>%
  distinct(country, city)

to_geocode <- anti_join(missing_coords, geo_cache_wave1, by = c("country", "city"))

# run geocoding
if (nrow(to_geocode) > 0) {
  geo_results <- to_geocode %>%
    slice_head(n = 20) %>% 
    geocode(
      city = city,
      country = country,
      method = "osm",
      lat = new_latitude,
      long = new_longitude,
      verbose = TRUE
    )
  
  geo_cache_wave1<- bind_rows(geo_cache_wave1, geo_results)

  geo_cache_unique <- geo_cache_wave1%>%
    group_by(country, city) %>%
    slice(1) %>%
    ungroup()
  
  # write cache
  write_csv(geo_cache_unique, cache_path)
}

# merge geocoding results back into df_all
df_all_geocoded <- df_all %>%
  left_join(geo_cache_wave1, by = c("country", "city")) %>%
  mutate(
    new_latitude = coalesce(new_latitude.x, new_latitude.y),
    new_longitude = coalesce(new_longitude.x, new_longitude.y)
  ) %>%
  select(-new_latitude.x, -new_latitude.y, -new_longitude.x, -new_longitude.y)

# write consolidated data
write_csv(df_all_geocoded, "data_processed/datasetWHO-consolidated-geocoded.csv")

```

```{r}

## First wave Geocoding Batching - Loop

library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(tidygeocoder)

cache_path <- "cache/cache_geocoded_city_country.csv"

if (file.exists(cache_path)) {
  geo_cache_wave1 <- read_csv(cache_path, show_col_types = FALSE)
  message("Using cached first-wave geocoding results...")

} else {
  geo_cache_wave1 <- tibble(country = character(), city = character(), new_latitude = numeric(), new_longitude = numeric())
}

iterations <- 6
batch_size <- 100
pause_seconds <- 5  

for (i in seq_len(iterations)) {
  message("Running batch ", i)

  missing_coords <- df_all %>%
    filter(is.na(new_latitude) | is.na(new_longitude)) %>%
    distinct(country, city)

  to_geocode <- anti_join(missing_coords, geo_cache_wave1, by = c("country", "city"))

  if (nrow(to_geocode) == 0) {
    message("All coordinates found. Stopping early at iteration ", i)
    break
  }

  geo_results <- to_geocode %>%
    slice_head(n = batch_size) %>%
    geocode(
      city = city,
      country = country,
      method = "osm",
      lat = new_latitude,
      long = new_longitude,
      verbose = TRUE
    )

  geo_cache_wave1 <- bind_rows(geo_cache_wave1, geo_results) %>%
    group_by(country, city) %>%
    slice(1) %>%
    ungroup()

  write_csv(geo_cache_wave1, cache_path)

  Sys.sleep(pause_seconds)
}

df_all_geocoded <- df_all %>%
  left_join(geo_cache_wave1, by = c("country", "city")) %>%
  mutate(
    new_latitude = coalesce(new_latitude.x, new_latitude.y),
    new_longitude = coalesce(new_longitude.x, new_longitude.y)
  ) %>%
  select(-new_latitude.x, -new_latitude.y, -new_longitude.x, -new_longitude.y)

write_csv(df_all_geocoded, "data_processed/datasetWHO-consolidated-geocoded.csv")


```

```{r}

## Second wave geocoding - non-city matching (landmarks etc)

library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(tidygeocoder)

geo_cache_failed_wave1 <- read_csv("cache/geo_cache_failed_wave1.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)

geo_query_data <- geo_cache_failed_wave1 %>%
  mutate(address = paste(city, country, sep = ", ")) %>%
  filter(!is.na(address), trimws(address) != "") %>%
  select(country, city, address)

second_wave_cache_file <- "cache/cache_geocoded_city_country_secondwave.csv"

if (file.exists(second_wave_cache_file)) {
  message("Using cached second-wave geocoding results...")
  geo_cache_wave2 <- read_csv(second_wave_cache_file, show_col_types = FALSE)
  geo_cache_wave2 <- geo_cache_wave2 %>% select(country, city, new_longitude, new_latitude)
} else {

  geo_results_wave2 <- geo_query_data %>%
    #slice_head(n = 10) %>%  # optional for testing
    geocode(
      address = "address",
      method = "osm",
      lat = "new_latitude",
      long = "new_longitude",
      verbose = TRUE,
      custom_query = list(limit = 1)
    )
  
  print(geo_results_wave2)

  geo_cache_success_wave1 <- read_csv("cache/geo_cache_success_wave1.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)

  geo_cache_wave2 <- bind_rows(
    geo_cache_success_wave1,
    geo_results_wave2
  ) %>%
    distinct(country, city, .keep_all = TRUE)
  geo_cache_wave2 <- geo_cache_wave2 %>% select(country, city, new_longitude, new_latitude)
  write_csv(geo_cache_wave2, second_wave_cache_file)
}

```

```{r}

## Third wave geocoding - manual review city names

geo_cache_manual_fixed <- read_csv("cache/geo_cache_manual_review_fixed.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)

geo_manual_to_geocode <- geo_cache_manual_fixed %>%
  transmute(
    country,
    city_fixed = iconv(city_fixed, from = "", to = "UTF-8", sub = "byte")
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(city_fixed), trimws(city_fixed) != "") %>%
  mutate(address = paste(city_fixed, country, sep = ", ")) %>%
  select(country, city_fixed, address)

geo_results_wave3 <- geo_manual_to_geocode %>%
#  slice_head(n = 10) %>% #testing
  geocode(
    address = "address",
    method = "osm",
    lat = "new_latitude",
    long = "new_longitude",
    verbose = TRUE,
    custom_query = list(limit = 1)
  ) %>%
  transmute(
    country,
    city = city_fixed,              
    new_latitude,
    new_longitude
  )

geo_cache_success_wave2 <- read_csv("cache/geo_cache_success_wave2.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)

if (!"new_latitude" %in% names(geo_cache_success_wave2) && "latitude" %in% names(geo_cache_success_wave2)) {
  geo_cache_success_wave2 <- geo_cache_success_wave2 %>% rename(new_latitude = latitude)
}
if (!"new_longitude" %in% names(geo_cache_success_wave2) && "longitude" %in% names(geo_cache_success_wave2)) {
  geo_cache_success_wave2 <- geo_cache_success_wave2 %>% rename(new_longitude = longitude)
}
geo_cache_success_wave2 <- geo_cache_success_wave2 %>%
  select(country, city, new_latitude, new_longitude)

geo_cache_success_wave2_filtered <- geo_cache_success_wave2 %>%
  anti_join(geo_results_wave3, by = c("country", "city"))

geo_cache_final <- bind_rows(
  geo_cache_success_wave2_filtered,
  geo_results_wave3
) %>%
  distinct(country, city, .keep_all = TRUE)

write_csv(geo_cache_final, "cache/cache_geocoded_city_country_final.csv")


```

```{r}

## Merge all

df_all_clean <- df_all %>%
  select(-any_of(c("new_latitude", "new_longitude")))

df_all_fixed <- df_all_clean %>%
  left_join(
    geo_cache_manual_fixed %>% select(country, city, city_fixed),
    by = c("country", "city")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    city_merge_key = coalesce(city_fixed, city)  # use fixed name if available, else original
  )

df_all_geocoded <- df_all_fixed %>%
  left_join(
    geo_cache_final,
    by = c("country", "city_merge_key" = "city")
  )

df_all_geocoded <- df_all_geocoded %>%
  select(-city_fixed, -city_merge_key)

write_csv(df_all_geocoded, "data_processed/datasetWHO-consolidated-geocoded.csv")

# check
df_final_na <- df_all_geocoded %>%
  filter(is.na(new_latitude) | is.na(new_longitude))

df_final_na %>%
  filter(!is.na(longitude) & !is.na(latitude)) %>%
  distinct(country, city, longitude, latitude, new_longitude, new_latitude)
```
